Master Mao has taken in many cats over the years. 
Some strays were lucky enough to have all four paws; others had been abandoned miles from home. Some were gravely ill—too tired to fight, their lives fading away within days. 
Some cats crossed his path by chance; he fed them for a while, and then found them new families. Others chose to stay with the old man. 
Maomao was the first cat he ever rescued. 
And perhaps... the one who will stay with him until the very end.
